hook: For half of the rational values a outside an interval, a maximal second iterate forces all iterates maximal.
summary: The paper gives a simpler proof of earlier results on when every iterate of x^2 + a has the largest possible Galois group, and extends them from integers to rational a. For a set of density 1/2 outside a certain interval, checking the second iterate suffices. It was produced with Claude and formalized in Lean, while the fourth-iterate conjecture rests only on experiments.
title: When do all iterates of $x^2 + a$ have maximal Galois group?
